name: gpu-vllm-t4-embed2
description: Manage vLLM serving of EmbeddingGemma 2 (google/embeddinggemma-2, Gemma 4-derived multimodal embedding model, 768-d with Matryoshka 512/256/128) on one NVIDIA Tesla T4 (Turing, SM 7.5) already attached to a Compute Engine VM, via the gpu-vllm-t4-embed2 MCP server: host capacity across three filesystems, stack verification against the rig's own PYTHONUSERBASE, the encoder-attention Triton clamp float32 needs on Turing, server lifecycle, and embedding tools that add the model's trained task prefixes (embed_text, rank_documents, verify_embeddings). Pooling runner on /v1/embeddings at float32, text + image. Measured 2026-10-07: 1-cos <= 7e-9 against sentence-transformers.
